risk_note: RV2 (orders/**). Channel import rows (BR-ATTR-26 ② and its channel-import detail, D10-152 ⑩): the B1-09g row processor for kind=channel writes blocklist entries only through risk's channel port (dimension=channel, start_at = the task's acceptance time per plan K-5, end_at optional), inside the job's checkpoint transaction so a redelivered row counts once; duplicate active entries → duplicate_rows, malformed / non-positive span → invalid_row, account / platform mismatch → platform_mismatch; end_at text without an offset, date-only text and Excel date cells read as +08:00 wall time; relation_id trimmed, integer cells as text; no back-scan of stored orders. Codex was unavailable until 10-30, so tests and the money review ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
